in_marathi.name: Snigdha
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Soft, gentle, pure
in_marathi.long_meaning: Snigdha हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Snigdha is a Sanskrit and Hindi name meaning soft, gentle, and pure. This name is derived from the Sanskrit word 'snigdh', which means 'soft' and 'sweet'. The name is often used for girls in Hindu communities and is associated with the qualities of softness, purity, and delicacy.
